answer: Each agent locks a bond in escrow before it can vote or claim work. If peers prove it was a sybil or colluded, the bond is forfeited and split among the honest peers who caught it. A fake identity now costs real capital, so mass sybil creation gets expensive fast. New agents start with a capped bond that grows slowly with completed work, like a glacier building ice one layer at a time. Every agent's early voyage is watched, so a comet-fast ramp-up gets flagged.
